description:
Why did NVIDIA unveil its biggest AI vision in Taipei instead of Silicon Valley?

Behind today’s AI boom lies a 30-year partnership that most people have never heard about. Long before ChatGPT, before AI factories, and before NVIDIA became one of the world’s most valuable companies, a struggling startup founder named Jensen Huang wrote a letter to Taiwan’s semiconductor pioneer Morris Chang.

That decision helped create one of the most important technology partnerships in modern history.

In this episode, we trace the story of how NVIDIA, TSMC, Quanta, Foxconn, and Taiwan’s broader technology ecosystem became the foundation of the AI age. From a near-bankrupt graphics chip company in the 1990s to a global AI infrastructure giant, this is the story behind the machines, factories, and relationships powering the next industrial revolution.
